text:
Priya (Finance): SupplyHub just submitted an invoice but there's no PO on the header and the approver routing is failing. Invoice attached: SH-2389. Amount $12,480. Can someone help route or do a manual match? cc @Jon (AP)

invoices-bot: Automated match check: No PO match found for invoice SH-2389. Reason: PO_LOOKUP_FAIL.

Jon (AP): @Priya can you paste the invoice header (vendor invoice number + remittance email) and any PO they referenced? I can try a manual match from the console.

Priya (Finance): Sure — header from PDF below:
```
Vendor: SupplyHub Inc.
Invoice #: SH-2389
Date: 2026-11-02
Total: $12,480.00
Line items: "Redwood Inference - GPU hours"
Remit-to: payments@supplyhub.com
Vendor reference: internal ref 4521-INT
```
Link: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/SH-2389.pdf

Leah (Accounting): Looks like they used an internal ref instead of our PO. I suspect PO 4521 is the correct one (procurement created it earlier). Can someone route to Mike L (Procurement) — he approves 45xx POs.

Jon (AP): I attempted to attach PO 4521 manually but the system returned: "approver not found for cost center eng-modeling" when trying to route. Holding payment for now.

invoices-bot: Approval routing failed: no approver configured for cost center "eng-modeling". Suggestion: set approver or change cost center to an existing one. Use /approver add or escalate to finance-ops.

SupplyHub Support: Hi Redwood team — SupplyHub here. We see a duplicate charge flagged on SH-2389. We issued a refund earlier for invoice SH-2170 and that may have caused the discrepancy. Please confirm if you received refund TXN ID R-77344. Contact: ops@supplyhub.com

Priya (Finance): Thanks — we have not received a refund record on our side. @Jon please hold payment until we confirm. :no_entry_sign:

Jon (AP): Holding payment and created ticket FIN-9472 for reconciliation. Leia — can you try changing the invoice cost center to "infra-eng"? That one has an approver on file.

Leah (Accounting): Done — updated cost center to infra-eng on the invoice record. Attempting manual route again.

invoices-bot: Manual routing success. Invoice SH-2389 routed to Mike L (Procurement) for approval. Status: Pending approval.

Mike L (Procurement): I'll take a look and confirm within 24h. If SupplyHub can send refund transaction ID or proof, we can reconcile and either void or mark as duplicate.
